title: Room
description: A single navigable room/screen. One entity per file, conventionally content/rooms/<id>.json.

background.description: Path to the room's background image asset, relative to the content package root.

npcIds.description: References content/npcs/*.json entities present in this room.

itemIds.description: References content/items/*.json entities initially present in this room (not attached to a specific hotspot).

exits.description: Navigation links from a hotspot in this room to another room.

hotspotId.description: References the id of a hotspot in this room's own hotspots[].
